subject: Observability add-ons: retention, trace sampling, and dashboard bundling options
messages:
From: Sarah Lin <sarah.lin@openbank.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwoodinference.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2028-06-11T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Observability add-ons: retention, trace sampling, dashboards - pricing ask

Hi Jordan / Kimberly,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — OpenBank's SRE and platform teams were impressed with the telemetry UI and the trace flamegraphs. We have a few concrete asks so we can scope budget and procurement:

- Target retention: we need log/metric retention options to 365 days for a subset of business-critical routes (approx 6 TB compressed/month). Can you provide price tiers for 30 / 90 / 180 / 365 days and how that impacts storage replication across regions?
- Tracing: our trace ingest is bursty (spikes during batch jobs). We also want a higher sampling budget for error traces. How do you price trace ingestion and sampling uplift?
- Dashboards: we like the advanced dashboard pack (role-based views + scheduled snapshots). Is that charged per seat or as a flat add-on? Any bundled discount if we buy retention + traces + dashboards?

Procurement will want an estimate to include in the next quarter plan. Can you send a short matrix (numbers we can show finance) and any standard commercial concessions for a 12-month commit vs a 6-month trial?

Thanks,

Sarah Lin
Director, Platform Engineering
OpenBank, Inc.

Attachments: none
From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sarah Lin <sarah.lin@openbank.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2028-06-11T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Observability add-ons: retention, trace sampling, dashboards - pricing ask

Hi Sarah — great to hear the demo landed well. I put together three pragmatic packaging options and attached a one-page matrix for quick review (OBS-pricing-matrix.xlsx) and a sample SOW for enterprise rollouts (sample-sow.docx). High level:  

Option A — Starter Observability (low friction)
- Retention: 30 days default (included)
- Traces: standard sampling (up to 1M spans/month)
- Dashboards: basic (up to 10 saved boards)
- Pricing: usage-based, no commit. Good for POC.

Option B — Extended Retention (recommended for mid-market)
- Retention tiers: 90 / 180 / 365 days priced per GB-month. Example: $0.075 / GB-month for 90d, $0.065 / GB-month for 180d, $0.058 / GB-month for 365d (volume tiers apply).
- Traces: base price covers up to 5M spans/month; additional spans billed at $40 / 1M spans. Error-boost sampling add-on: +25% on trace bill to increase sampling of error traces (applied to billing span count).
- Dashboards: advanced pack available as seat-based add-on ($20 / seat / month) or as an org license ($2,500 / month) for unlimited seats.

Option C — Enterprise Observability Suite (savings + SLA)
- 12-month commitment required. Includes: 365d retention for up to 8 TB/month at discounted $0.045 / GB-month, trace uplift included up to 20M spans/month, advanced dashboards (org license) and 24/7 incident support.
- Commercial concessions: for a $200k ARR commit we can offer a 22% discount off list and a one-time onboarding credit of $12k to offset migration ingest.

Notes / clarifications:
- Replication across regions (e.g., us-east + eu-west) is charged at an incremental storage multiplier (approx +20% per additional replica). If regional isolation is required for regulated routes we can price a dedicated retention bucket.
- Pilot pricing: 6-month pilot can be structured as Option B priced at a 15% committed rate if OpenBank commits to a minimum monthly baseline (we typically use $25k/mo minimum for observability pilots).
- Billing mechanics: we meter ingest (GB) and span counts, dashboard seats separately. We also offer a blended slab for customers who prefer predictable billing.

Next steps: 1) If helpful I can schedule a 30-minute call with Karthik (product) and Kimberly (commercial) to walk the matrix and align on a path-to-commit; 2) we can share a draft amendment and pilot SOW for procurement.

Jordan Blake
Head of Solutions — Redwood Inference
jordan_blake@redwoodinference.com | +1 415-555-0199

Attachments: OBS-pricing-matrix.xlsx, sample-sow.docx
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2028-06-11T13:42:00-07:00
Subject: FW: Observability pricing — internal notes and concession thinking

Jordan / Karthik — I listened in on the demo notes and captured a few negotiation levers in case OpenBank presses:

- Commit threshold: target $200k ARR for 22% discount (Option C). If they can only do $120k ARR, offer 15% and require a 9-month minimum.
- Pilot concession: for procurement approvals we can offer a 6-month pilot at 30% off list pricing but with a retroactive credit if they convert to a 12-month commit within 90 days after pilot completion (credit applies only to retention storage charges).
- Waive onboarding credit only for deals > $300k ARR; otherwise cap to $7k.
- Legal / compliance: product needs to confirm regional replication SLA and retention export path for eDiscovery requests (OpenBank asked specifically about audit log export).

I've attached a short file (pricing_call_notes.txt) with the three scenarios and our suggested cadence for procurement paperwork. If we move forward, I recommend we prepare a lightweight amendment template that covers retention tiers + SLAs + audit export language so procurement can sign quickly.

Kimberly Park
Director, Commercial Programs — Redwood Inference

Attachments: pricing_call_notes.txt
From: Sarah Lin <sarah.lin@openbank.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: OpenBank Procurement <procurement@openbank.com>, Mike Chen <mike.chen@openbank.com>
Date: 2028-06-12T08:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Observability add-ons: retention, trace sampling, dashboards - pricing ask

Jordan / Kimberly — thanks for the thorough breakdown and the matrix — that was helpful. A few follow ups from procurement and platform: 

- Procurement asks if you can do a 30% discount on Option B for a 6-month pilot (we would be willing to commit to a baseline $18k/mo during pilot). You mentioned 15% — procurement is pushing for bigger concession to get the pilot greenlit.
- We need written confirmation that audit logs (retention buckets) can be exported daily and that retention metadata is included for eDiscovery. Can you confirm technical feasibility?
- For dashboards: we prefer org license but want to understand how many named seats are considered admins vs viewers — is there an admin seat surcharge?
- Timeline: procurement wants to upload the signed NDA (attached) and have a pilot SOW ready to sign by end of month. Can you send a DocuSign link for the SOW + amendment?

CC: procurement@openbank.com (they will handle the commercial redline).

Best,

Sarah Lin
Director, Platform Engineering
OpenBank, Inc.

Attachments: openbank-nda-signed.pdf
